legs.label: Prepare the Stage-2 agenda
legs.description: Project the EL2 threads into a stable agenda for Raven.
legs.lead: AX projects Ledger thread events into the agenda the walk will exhaust.
beats: Reads library.thread_opened events from the project Ledger, scoped to the bundle.
Writes runtime/front-of-house/agenda.json with stable item ids.
Stages the first item for Raven without asking the director at launch.

legs.label: Stage the next unresolved agenda item
legs.description: Pick the next agenda item not yet answered or residualed and write it for Raven.
legs.lead: AX walks the agenda in order, skipping items already answered or carried as residual.
beats: Reads the agenda and this run's answer and residual Ledger events.
If a proposed index-card gate is pending, re-stages that gate before ordinary agenda selection.
Writes the next unresolved item to current-item.json, current-item.md, and for-raven.md.
Reports AGENDA_DONE once every item is answered or residualed.

legs.label: Review the current Front-of-House turn through Raven
legs.description: On the first frame-origin wake, Raven opens with the banked product-map frame gate; on a proposed-card wake, Raven asks for approve-or-correct; later wakes mediate one agenda item.
legs.lead: The run waits; Raven turns the staged artifact into a director-facing comprehension check.
beats: Raven banks the staged turn as an agent Ledger event before speaking.
For the frame-origin first wake, Raven presents the plain product map first, then carries any story/container reconciliations as separate rulings.
For a proposed index-card wake, Raven presents only the AX-rendered card and asks the director to approve it or give one correction.
For later wakes, Raven mediates the current item and evidence refs at section/shape altitude.
The director's agreed answer returns through ax raven answer and is banked as actor.kind=user.

legs.label: Resolve proposed index-card gate if staged
legs.description: Classify the director's proposed-card answer before ordinary patch planning.
legs.lead: AX keeps the proposed-card gate separate from agenda items and routes approval, correction, or residual.
beats: Returns NOT_KEYSTONE_GATE for ordinary agenda answers.
On approval, applies the deferred agenda projection from the stored frame mapping.
On first correction, writes the correction artifact for the one mapping revision pass.
On second rejection, records the proposed-card gate as a residual and lets the walk continue.

legs.label: Plan the director-backed bundle patch
legs.description: Convert the director answer into a narrow patch file that AX can validate.
legs.lead: The agent drafts structure changes only; AX owns the actual write.
beats: Reads the answer receipt and current agenda item.
Drafts a patch that cites the user answer event id.
For frame mappings, writes containerMapping only; AX renders the proposed index card.
Limits edits to names, context, plane, status, and relationships.

legs.label: Validate or reject the bundle patch
legs.description: Classify the planned patch as applied or rejected, appending accepted patches to the draft log when one is bound.
legs.lead: AX enforces provenance and the Small-floor frontmatter boundary, then emits a routing marker.
beats: Rejects patches without a matching actor.kind=user answer event.
Preserves card bodies and required Small-floor fields.
For frame mappings, appends the derived card fan-out and proposed index card to the draft log, then stages the proposed-card gate.
Appends accepted patches to the draft log when bound, otherwise mutates bundle cards.
Appends a bundle_patch_applied event for accepted patches or writes a patch-rejection diagnostic.

legs.label: Replan the rejected bundle patch once
legs.description: Give the agent one repair turn with AX's exact validation error.
legs.lead: The agent corrects the patch, not the director answer.
beats: Reads runtime/front-of-house/patch-rejection.json.
Uses the exact validation error as the repair target.
Writes a replacement patch for the same agenda item and answer event.

legs.label: Validate or reject the replanned bundle patch
legs.description: Append or apply the repaired patch, or classify the second rejection.
legs.lead: A second patch rejection no longer strands the rest of the agenda.
beats: Appends valid repaired patches to the draft log when bound, otherwise applies them to bundle cards.
Writes a fresh patch-rejection diagnostic for invalid repaired patches.
Routes second rejection to residual accounting instead of another replan.

legs.label: Revise the frame mapping for the proposed index card once
legs.description: Give the planner one correction pass after the director rejects the proposed index card.
legs.lead: The planner revises the mapping, not the index-card body.
beats: Reads the pending gate, proposed draft, original mapping, and correction answer.
Writes one replacement containerMapping patch using the correction answer event.
Does not author keystoneDraft or enumerate whole-container card membership.

legs.label: Validate or reject the revised frame mapping
legs.description: Validate the one revised mapping and either re-stage the proposed card or residual the failed correction.
legs.lead: AX renders the second proposed card deterministically and prevents an unbounded correction loop.
beats: Renders and validates a new proposed index card from the revised mapping.
Routes a valid revision back to the director as attempt 2.
Routes an invalid revision to residual accounting instead of another planner loop.

legs.label: Record rejected patch as residual
legs.description: Carry an item whose patch failed twice into the existing residual-gap path.
legs.lead: The walk keeps moving while preserving the failed validation reason.
beats: Reads the current item and patch-rejection diagnostic.
Appends library.front_of_house.residual_gap_recorded with a patch rejected reason.
Allows stage-next to continue to later agenda items.

legs.label: Prepare ruling-aware agenda triage
legs.description: Build the closed triage input from remaining agenda items and banked rulings.
legs.lead: AX decides whether there is enough settled material to ask an ACP pass for agenda triage.
beats: Reads agenda.json plus the Ledger events for this run.
Skips triage when there are no banked rulings or no eligible candidate items.
Writes runtime/front-of-house/triage-input.json and emits TRIAGE_READY when judgment is useful.

legs.label: Classify remaining agenda against banked rulings
legs.description: Conservatively classify not-yet-staged agenda items as unaffected, answered, or reframed.
legs.lead: The ACP pass generalizes from director rulings without editing durable project state.
beats: Reads only the prepared triage input.
Cites ruling event ids for every answered or reframed decision.
Writes only runtime/front-of-house/triage.json.

legs.label: Apply ruling-aware agenda triage
legs.description: Validate triage output, append process-authored settlements, and preserve reframed originals.
legs.lead: AX keeps machine-made triage distinct, audited, and reopenable.
beats: Rejects invalid or incomplete ACP output as TRIAGE_SKIPPED without mutation.
Records answered items through residual_gap_recorded with the settled-by-triage reason prefix.
Rewrites only runtime agenda text for reframed items while preserving original wording.

legs.label: Finalize residual-gap accounting
legs.description: Write RESIDUAL-GAPS.md for every agenda item not answered or explicitly residualed.
legs.lead: Nothing disappears: every unanswered item is carried forward.
beats: Compares the full agenda with answer and residual Ledger events.
Appends residual_gap_recorded events for unanswered items.
Writes RESIDUAL-GAPS.md.
